mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Enemy of the Forest</titleLeft><mainText>It's time for Ivern's revenge. Ivern can damage monsters, and they can damage him.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: Ivern the Cruel</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ivern places a shield on an ally which explodes after a short duration slowing and damaging enemies. The shield refreshes if it hits no enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Ivern grants @TotalShield@ Shield to an ally champion or Daisy. After @ShieldDuration@ seconds, it bursts, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slowing enemies by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

If Triggerseed detonates and no enemy champions are hit while the shield still persists, the ally will be shielded for @TotalShield@ for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ivern cannot attack or be attacked by non-epic monsters. Ivern can create magical groves on jungle camps which grow over time. When the grove is fully grown, Ivern may free the monsters to receive gold and experience.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Ivern will not hurt non-epic monsters. Instead, Ivern can right click a monster to grow a Grove that costs @HealthTooltip@ Health and @ManaTooltip@ Mana.

Groves:
  • Grow over @HarvestDuration@ second(s)
  • Once fully grown, Ivern can harvest them, freeing the camp and earning gold and experience
  • Ivern can also Smite the Groves to instantly grow and free the camp, earning gold and experience@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Friend of the Forest</titleLeft><mainText>Ivern has placed a grove on this camp.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Ivern conjures a vine dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Rooting the first enemy hit for @RootDuration@ seconds. Allies that Attack a Rooted enemy dash into Attack Range.

Recast: Ivern dashes directly onto the Rooted enemy.

Hitting non-epic monsters reduces Rootcaller's cooldown by 50%.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Rootcaller</titleLeft><mainText>Ivern can dash to the rooted target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Re-cast command Daisy to attack or move.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Ivern summons his sentinel friend Daisy to leap into the fray for @DaisyDuration@ seconds.

Daisy, Slam!: Daisy's 3rd consecutive Attack on the same champion or epic monster will launch a shockwave, dealing @TotalShockwaveDamage@ magic damage to all enemies hit as well as Knocking Up for @ShockwaveCCDuration@ second. This effect can only occur once every @ShockwaveCD@ seconds.

Recast: Instruct Daisy to Attack or move.
Send Daisy to attack an enemy or move to a position. Target Ivern himself to order Daisy to follow.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Brushmaker</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has bonus damage on their attacks.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: While in brush and for @BuffDuration@ seconds after leaving, Ivern's Attacks deal an additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage. Nearby allies will gain this effect for @AllyBuffDuration@ seconds and deal @TotalAllyDamage@ magic damage.

Active: Ivern grows a patch of Brush, revealing the area for @RevealDuration@ seconds. The Brush persists until Ivern's team loses vision within it, or up to @MaxBrushDuration@ seconds.
